author: JerryRigEverything
description:
Rivian bravely let me behind the wheel of their new Rivian R2 which begins deliveries this spring. Today we check out what this new Rivian R2 brings to the table and how it compares to the Tesla Model Y or the Toyota RAV 4  or the Honda CRV.  

Check Current pricing and official specs HERE: https://rivian.com/configurations/list?reprCode=ZACK1594426
title: Rivian R2 OFF ROAD - Everything you need to know!
